medicina.titulo: New strategy may target common cancer driver with minimal side effects
medicina.resumo: Researchers have found a surprisingly common vulnerability in a broad variety of cancers and have begun designing drug compounds to exploit it, in a study led by investigators at Weill Cornell Medicine. The findings suggest the possibility of a potent, low-side-effect treatment that could benefit many patients with colorectal, breast and other cancer types.

medicina.titulo: STAT+: The health care affordability midterms, and billing urgent care as ER
medicina.resumo: Health care affordability is a major issue for voters, and a new kind of medical clinic sticks some patients with big bills.

medicina.titulo: Engineers address key hurdle for exhaled breath diagnostics
medicina.resumo: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), a chronic condition that causes increasing difficulty in breathing as it progresses, is the third leading cause of death worldwide. The clinical diagnosis and monitoring of COPD and other pulmonary diseases can be taxing, often requiring blood testing, which can be uncomfortable for patients, or costly imaging procedures, such as CT scans. Additionally, COPD flare-ups can occur unexpectedly and progress rapidly, significantly increasing the risk of death.

medicina.titulo: Surgery offers best survival for early-stage lung cancer, study finds
medicina.resumo: Surgery should remain the primary treatment for people with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who are suitable for either surgery or a highly targeted form of radiotherapy, a new study from the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM) suggests.

biologia.titulo: A CRISPR gene boost reduces seizures and strengthens muscles in mice
biologia.resumo: Some genetic diseases leave cells without a crucial protein. One possible treatment is to persuade genes already inside those cells to work harder, but the necessary machinery can be difficult to deliver, especially when researchers want to target several genes at once. A new compact CRISPR system devised by Hainan Zhang of the Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and colleagues fits those instructions into a single viral delivery package.

biologia.titulo: Predicting jumping genes' roles in changing genome size
biologia.resumo: A genome contains all of the DNA of every living organism, but its contents don't stop there—most of these structures also contain snippets of DNA that can copy and paste themselves to "infect" a genome, expanding its size. Precisely why that happens remains a mystery.

biologia.titulo: Automated platform optimizes enzyme production using cell-free protein synthesis and AI-driven design
biologia.resumo: Enzymes are essential to a wide range of industrial processes. As biocatalysts, they play a key role in producing active pharmaceutical ingredients, specialty chemicals and ingredients for cosmetics, besides being vital to the food industry. Enzymes allow many chemical reactions to occur under milder conditions, thereby saving energy and making existing processes more efficient and environmentally friendly.

biologia.titulo: Dinosaur blood—oldest discovery rewrites what fossils can reveal about the past
biologia.resumo: An international research team led by Curtin University has for the first time uncovered unequivocal evidence of fossilized red blood cells and amino acids of collagen, reshaping our understanding of fossil preservation and molecular longevity in deep time.

robotica.titulo: ChatGPT vai juntar conversas e agentes de IA no mesmo lugar do app
robotica.resumo: A OpenAI vai unificar as abas “Chat” e “Work” no ChatGPT . Dessa forma, a conversa padrão e o agente de IA do Work poderão ser acessados na mesma caixa de prompt, sem a necessidade de alternar entre os modos na tela inicial. A empresa começou a informar aos assinantes dos planos pagos do ChatGPT sobre a mudança, que será testada com um grupo limitado de contas a partir das próximas semanas. A divisão entre abas existe na versão web e nos aplicativos para computadores e celulares. O ajuste s implifica a experiência de uso , visto que uma tarefa pode conversar no chat padrão e depois ser encaminhada para o agente do Work. “Isso vai permitir avançar da exploração de uma ideia até a execução pelo ChatGPT, tudo no mesmo lugar”, explica a empresa em comunicado. O ChatGPT Work foi lançado pela OpenAI em julho e funciona como um agente autônomo para executar diferentes tarefas. A ferramenta pode acessar documentos no computador, combinar ações entre apps — o usuário delega as funções e acompanha todo o processo, sempre com a opção de intervir no meio do caminho. software.resumo: Version 16.0 of the Tor Browser has been released. This is the first stable version based on Firefox ESR 153. Notable changes in this release include support for Linux on 64-bit Arm, redesigned settings, and a "generic window titles" feature to help prevent other applications from snooping on one's browser activity. Tor Browser for Android has had a number of interface updates to Google's Material Design 3 design language. This release also follows Firefox in ending support for 32-bit x86 Linux systems. See the full changelog for all of the updates and bug fixes.

astrofisica.titulo: Dust-shrouded Milky Way star cluster may be nearly as old as the universe
astrofisica.resumo: Astronomers have determined that VVV CL001, a metal-poor globular cluster near the center of the Milky Way, is about 13.4 billion years old, making it one of the oldest known star clusters in our galaxy. The cluster lies behind thick clouds of interstellar dust, which made its distance and age difficult to establish. The paper, outlining the methodology for estimating its age and distance, was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Oct. 20. It has been accepted for publication by Astronomy & Astrophysics.

inteligencia_artificial.resumo: A recent scroll through social media got me thinking about trust. About half my feed was filled with AI slop that astute users would call out as being machine-generated, often to the embarrassment of the rube who unknowingly spread it and sometimes to the delight of the poster who shared it deliberately because they found it amusing or useful for sowing confusion. Remember the good old days of GPT-3 when we could ask the chatbot anything and it would almost instantly and very confidently spit back a plausible but false answer? That’s when the word “hallucination” as applied to AI answers entered the lexicon. Six years and several versions of a few different chatbots later, I still can’t trust the answers I get, even though Claude or Gemini often do useful work for me. That’s the thing about current AI: Trust but verify. And verify you must. Apply that maxim at scale to maintain the integrity of the scientific record and you get an idea of the challenge facing publishers of peer-reviewed scholarship. inteligencia_artificial.titulo: Qual é a diferença entre rodar uma IA local e uma IA na nuvem?
inteligencia_artificial.resumo: Na hora de usar uma inteligência artificial, você já parou para pensar onde ela processa suas solicitações ? Algumas ferramentas funcionam no próprio computador ou celular, já outras dependem de servidores externos. Essa diferença afeta a privacidade dos seus dados, os recursos disponíveis, os custos e a necessidade de estar conectado à internet. O modelo escolhido também influencia o tipo de tarefa que você pode realizar. Uma IA local pode ajudar a revisar textos e resumir documentos sem enviar os arquivos para servidores externos, desde que o programa funcione inteiramente no dispositivo. Já os serviços na nuvem oferecem acesso a modelos que podem lidar com solicitações mais complexas, mesmo em aparelhos com pouca capacidade de processamento. Mas como saber qual opção vale mais a pena? A resposta depende do que você precisa fazer, do equipamento disponível e do cuidado necessário com as informações compartilhadas. Qual é a diferença entre uma IA local e uma IA na nuvem? A principal diferença entre uma IA local e uma IA na nuvem está no ambiente onde o processamento acontece . energia_materiais.titulo: Robot platform combines AI and rapid imaging to improve perovskite solar cell fabrication
energia_materiais.resumo: Solar cells generate electricity by absorbing sunlight in a thin layer of perovskite, a light-absorbing material. This layer is made with a liquid solution that dries and crystallizes into a solid film, but small changes in temperature, humidity and other conditions can affect the film and the performance of the solar cell.

energia_materiais.titulo: New coating approach aligns molecules upright to boost organic solar cell efficiency
energia_materiais.resumo: Solar cells, devices that can convert sunlight into electricity, are now widely used in many countries worldwide. While most cells on the market today are primarily made of silicon, energy engineers have been exploring the potential of other materials that produce an electrical voltage when light is directed at them.
It's hard to ignore the difference: You can fill a car's tank with gas in mere minutes. Charging the battery of an electric vehicle (EV) can take 30 minutes or more.

energia_materiais.titulo: IceCube detects ghost particles with 10 billion times the energy of solar neutrinos
energia_materiais.resumo: Mysterious particles called neutrinos constantly stream through our bodies, and scientists are now detecting incredibly powerful versions arriving from distant cosmic sources using a massive observatory buried in Antarctic ice. These elusive “ghost particles” could hold extraordinary clues about the Big Bang, extreme cosmic events, and some of the universe’s greatest mysteries.
